mapper.select: SELECT AUTH_ID, AUTH_DEFINE, USED_YN FROM TBL_AUTH_INFO WHERE USED_YN = 1 ORDER BY AUTH_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_AUTH_INFO WHERE AUTH_ID = #{_parameter} AND USED_YN = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_AUTH_INFO (AUTH_ID, AUTH_DEFINE, USED_YN, REG_YDT, UPDATE_YDT) VALUES (#{authId}, #{authDefine}, #{usedYn}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_AUTH_INFO SET AUTH_DEFINE = #{authDefine}, UPDATE_YDT = NOW() WHERE AUTH_ID = #{authId} AND USED_YN = 1
mapper.select: SELECT URL FROM TBL_AUTH_URL WHERE AUTH_ID = #{_parameter} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND URL IS NOT NULL

SELECT T.IDX AS idx, T.SUB_IDX AS subIdx, #{_parameter} AS authId, T.URL AS url, T.AUTH_URL_NAME1 AS authUrlName1, T.AUTH_URL_NAME2 AS authUrlName2, T.AUTH_URL_NAME3 AS authUrlName3, CASE WHEN A.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS useYn FROM TBL_AUTH_URL T LEFT JOIN TBL_AUTH_URL A ON A.AUTH_ID = #{_parameter} AND A.URL = T.URL WHERE T.AUTH_ID = 1 AND T.URL IS NOT NULL AND T.URL != '' ORDER BY CASE T.AUTH_URL_NAME1 WHEN '대시보드' THEN 1 WHEN '사용자 관리' THEN 2 WHEN '소속기관 관리' THEN 3 WHEN '장치 관리' THEN 4 WHEN '검색 & 모니터링' THEN 5 WHEN '장애 관리' THEN 6 WHEN '자료실' THEN 7 WHEN '설정' THEN 8 ELSE 99 END, CASE T.AUTH_URL_NAME2 WHEN '목록' THEN 1 WHEN '등록' THEN 2 WHEN '상세' THEN 3 WHEN '수정' THEN 4 WHEN '삭제' THEN 5 WHEN '다운로드' THEN 6 ELSE 50 END, T.URL
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TBL_AUTH_URL (IDX, SUB_IDX, AUTH_ID, URL, AUTH_URL_NAME1, AUTH_URL_NAME2, AUTH_URL_NAME3, USE_YN) SELECT CONCAT(#{_parameter}, SUBSTRING(T.IDX, LOCATE('_', T.IDX))), T.SUB_IDX, #{_parameter}, T.URL, T.AUTH_URL_NAME1, T.AUTH_URL_NAME2, T.AUTH_URL_NAME3, 'N' FROM TBL_AUTH_URL T WHERE T.AUTH_ID = 1 AND T.URL IS NOT NULL AND T.URL != ''
